subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 9: Get ready for … Pre A1 Starters
outcomes: I can look at a picture and write Yes or No.
I can answer questions about a picture.
I can unscramble letters to write activities.

tf.s: In this test, you write Yes or No, not Y or N.
tf.why: Yes! Always write the full words Yes or No.

tf.s: You can write Y for Yes in this test.
tf.why: You must write the full word Yes.

tf.s: For 'He plays tennis on Sundays', you check the day and the activity.
tf.why: Great! Check the day and the activity in the picture.

tf.s: You only check the activity, not the day.
tf.why: Check both: the day and the activity.

tf.s: We say: He plays tennis on Sundays.
tf.why: Right! With he, we add -s: plays.

tf.s: We say: He play tennis on Sundays.
When you unscramble, you cross out each letter you use.
tf.why: Yes! Crossing out helps you use each letter once.

tf.s: You can use one letter two times when you unscramble.
tf.why: Use each letter only one time.

tf.s: The letters e-r-d-a make the word read.
The letters k-i-t-e make the word bike.

boxes.q: Complete: He ___ read books at the weekend.
Complete: He always ___ a bike on Fridays.
How many letters are in bike?
Which word tells us how often?
Why do we count the dashes?
boxes.why: Counting dashes helps us check the spelling.
listen to music has more than one word.

boxes.q: Answer: When does he do karate? (picture: Monday)
Which sentence is about the weekend?

hunt.q: Unscramble: s n i n e t
Unscramble: k o o b s
Unscramble: a k s d t o b r a e
Unscramble: c i s u m

mcq.q: In Reading and Writing Part 2, what do you write?
mcq.why: We write the full words Yes or No.

mcq.q: Which is a day of the week?
mcq.why: Wednesday is a day of the week.

mcq.q: The picture shows a boy playing tennis on Sunday. Sentence: He plays tennis on Sundays. What do you write?
mcq.why: The picture and the sentence match, so we write Yes.

mcq.q: The picture shows the boy reading a book on Saturday. Sentence: He doesn't read books at the weekend. What do you write?
mcq.why: He reads on Saturday, so the sentence is wrong: No.

mcq.q: Picture: he watches TV on Wednesdays. Answer: What does he do on Wednesdays?
Why do we cross out letters when we unscramble a word?
o: So we don't use a letter twice
So we can find the day
So we don't need to read
mcq.why: Crossing out stops us using a letter two times.

mcq.q: Sentence: He often watches TV on Wednesdays. What do you check in the picture?
mcq.why: Check the day and the activity before you write Yes or No.

mcq.q: A boy never rides a bike. Which sentence is correct?
o: He rides a bike on Fridays.
mcq.why: Never means he doesn't do it.
